questions.prompt: Which PROUD value is this module grounded in?
What's the deck's framing of professionalism?
options: A set of habits - and the habits don't change with the setting
questions.explanation: Professionalism isn't a costume - it's a set of habits that don't change with the setting.

questions.prompt: Which of these are the four professional habits the deck lists? Select all that apply.
options: Turning up - on time, kit charged, files backed up
How you speak to people - in the room, in the group chat, and online
Owning mistakes and putting them right
questions.explanation: All four are the professional habits - same across college, placement, and employment.

questions.prompt: What does the deck say matters for your reference?
options: The pattern across the year - which is the one thing you fully control
questions.explanation: One rough week doesn't follow you. A pattern does - and that's the one thing you fully control.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank: at entry level, the deciding factors are ____.
questions.template: At entry level, the deciding factors are ____.
questions.explanation: At entry level, employers consistently report that the deciding factors are human.

questions.prompt: Which of these is one of the six human skills in the deck?
questions.explanation: Initiative: spotting what needs doing without being asked.

questions.prompt: Which version of a strength statement lands as evidence?
options: 'On our last project I chaired the planning and set the deadlines - everyone knew their job, and we submitted on time'

questions.prompt: What does the deck say if you can't find three strengths?
options: You're not short of strengths - you're short of practice noticing them
